annotations.title: Change a group's name, contacts or notes

description: Changes: overwrites one group's name, company, primary contact or guest notes, or adds an internal note; never its dates, cut-off, rooms, rate or terms. Previews first: the first call shows the change and makes nothing. Changes a group's name, company, primary contact or guest notes, or adds an internal note on top. Never its dates, cut-off, held rooms, rate, terms or lock: those stay in the PMS. First call without confirm: a preview, nothing changes; then call again with the same values, confirm true and preview_id. One of the two people the owner named. Needs the owner's sign-in.

confirm.description: true to make the change shown in the preview

internal_notes.description: A note for the hotel's staff only; added on top of the group's internal notes

notes.description: Notes for the group's guests (shown on its booking page)
